title: From contract to commission: a clearer path to payout
excerpt: See how contract details, commission rules, payout timing, and human review fit into one connected workflow.
author: AI Accounting Agency

sections.heading: Start with the agreement
paragraphs: A commission calculation starts before anyone opens a spreadsheet. It starts with the agreement: the services sold, the contract value, the salesperson, and the terms that determine when a commission becomes eligible.

When those details are spread across documents and trackers, each payout cycle can require another round of checking. A connected workflow brings the relevant information together so the team has a consistent starting point.

sections.heading: Make the rules explicit
paragraphs: Upfront and recurring commissions can follow different rules. Rates, contract terms, and payout timing need to be clear before a calculation is useful. The goal is to reflect the compensation structure your business has agreed to, with enough context for a reviewer to understand the result.
Missing or conflicting information needs attention. A workflow should surface those exceptions for review instead of quietly turning an assumption into a payout record.

sections.heading: Give the team a useful view
paragraphs: A commission workspace connects contract activity with earnings, dated payout schedules, and reports. That gives sales and finance a shared way to discuss what has been calculated and what is coming next.

Forecasts serve a different purpose: they help explore possible outcomes under selected assumptions. Keeping forecasts distinct from recorded earnings and scheduled payouts helps the team interpret each view correctly.

sections.heading: Keep financial judgment in the process
paragraphs: Automation can organize information and handle repeatable calculations. Your team still needs to review exceptions, confirm the rules, and control payout decisions.

The best place to begin is your current process. Identify where contract information arrives, how commission rules are recorded, and which checks happen before a payout. Those details guide a practical implementation of Sales Commission.
